plan_card.why: Stop Codex from inventing actions by forcing PLAN to reference only contract-declared argv actions.
plan_card.what: Materialize a plan artifact (plan.json) and enforce that EXEC dispatches only actions declared in contract.json.
plan_card.how: Planner emits plan.json listing steps {action, argv_ref, expected_evidence}; controller validates plan against contract before exec.
plan_card.where: xtrl runner: PLAN stage + pre-exec validation

notes: Introduce plan.json as a run artifact (raw/plan.json or evidence/plan.json) containing only action names that exist in contract.json actions{}.
Controller must deny any plan step referencing an undeclared action or argv mismatch (reason PLAN_ILLEGAL_ACTION).
Keep actions argv-only; no shell wrapper introduction in this packet.
